title: Understanding Reconstruction Loss
text: Reconstruction loss measures how much information is lost when reducing the dimensionality of the data. It is calculated using the singular values in the matrix S.

title: Using Singular Values
text: The singular values in matrix S indicate the amount of variance captured by each principal component. The reconstruction loss is related to the singular values that are not used.

title: Calculating Reconstruction Loss
text: The reconstruction loss is the sum of the squares of the singular values that are not used in the reduced dimensionality. In this case, consider the singular values in S that correspond to the unused principal components.
